npcs.name: Elias
npcs.title: Wandering Scholar
npcs.greeting: So many curious creatures around Prontera, and so little time to study them all.

steps.name: A Scholar's Request
steps.description: A scholar named Elias is looking for help in Prontera.

dialog.say: Ah, a traveler! I'm Elias. I study the creatures that live around Prontera.

dialog: The Porings outside the South Gate have been acting strangely. Could you defeat <color=#CC762A>5 Porings</color> so I can study the jelly they leave behind?

steps.name: Jelly Samples
steps.description: Defeat 5 Porings at the Prontera South Gate for Elias
steps.objective: Defeat Porings at the South Gate

steps.name: Back to the Scholar
steps.description: Bring the jelly samples back to Elias in Prontera.
dialog: You're back already? This jelly is perfect. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this for your trouble.
